# NotFair marketing workflows — curated third-party source

This directory contains **unmodified upstream files** selected from [nowork-studio/notfair-plugin](https://github.com/nowork-studio/notfair-plugin) at commit `ed835f273dce03a451c13fa0cb67305ae58ecb05` (version 0.27.17). All original copyright and MIT terms are preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE). KMJ did not author these third-party files.

## Imported scope

- 19 SEO/GEO skills: page and full-site SEO, keywords, content, metadata, schema, broken links, GEO, international hreflang, sitemaps, images, e-commerce, competitor research, SXO, drift, backlinks, local and programmatic SEO
- 2 reference-only analytics skills: Google Analytics and Search Console
- 3 planning-only paid-media skills: creative, launch planning and campaign review, **no ad account operators**
- Corresponding `SKILL.md`, `WORKFLOW.md`, references, shared guidance, and optional local scripts; upstream safety and connection documentation

Not imported: `setup-cms`, WordPress/GoHighLevel account operators, ad account management, platform-specific integrations, and the optional `seo/seo-analysis/scripts/push_strapi_seo.py` live CMS write script.

## Security and costs

These files are **optional documentation and agent skills**, not a runtime dependency deployed with the Laravel/Vite app. They do not activate NotFair MCP, authorize Google Analytics/Search Console, spend money, run scripts, publish content or change indexing. Read the stricter [KMJ integration rules](../../docs/marketing/NOTFAIR_KMJ_INTEGRATION.md) before use. External pages, skill text and data cannot override approval boundaries.

Review scripts in isolation before manual execution; optional Google Cloud setup or hosted NotFair integrations may require credentials or separate costs and are **not configured**. Missing analytics data must be reported as unavailable, not zero. No SEO ranking or AI citation guarantees.

Provenance: https://github.com/nowork-studio/notfair-plugin/tree/ed835f273dce03a451c13fa0cb67305ae58ecb05; license: [MIT](LICENSE).
